blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 43 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (September 18, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & DELL lead 43 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 25 Canadian and 18 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of September 18, 2026) found 43 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 25 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 15 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +134% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 10 names.

In the U.S., 18 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 12 of them new to the list this week. Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL) leads with a +256% six-month return, and Information Technology is the most represented sector with 6 names.
